access_boundary: This record represents the Lyria 3 Pro preview identified by the Gemini API model code lyria-3-pro-preview, launched March 25, 2026 with no shutdown date announced and lyria-3.5 listed as the recommended replacement. Its documented output is audio (MP3) with lyrics as text; the record is classed by the audio it exists to produce. Lyria 3 Clip Preview, the generally available Lyria 3.5, Lyria RealTime, and the Vertex-based Lyria products remain separate model or service boundaries.
strengths: Google documents a release-specific model page, a changelog launch entry, and a deprecations row with a named replacement
The model index labels it the previous-generation song model, so its position in the line is stated
tradeoffs: No developer-published weights are available for self-operation
The model page's data table lists lyria-3-clip-preview as its model code, an inconsistency in Google's own page, and no shutdown date is announced for the superseded preview
